recipes.purpose: Verify actual reported reference version before any experiment.
recipes.limits: Placeholder executable identity must be replaced by an acquired, hashed distribution and runtime manifest.

recipes.purpose: Capture machine-converted values with structured XMP, location/instance groups and native IDs/context.
recipes.limits: -n is not exact raw bytes or Rational API data. Preserve raw stdout, reject duplicate JSON keys, and prove coverage on each fixture. Unknown binary blocks may require separate passes.

recipes.purpose: Capture display conversion separately under recorded locale/timezone conditions.
recipes.limits: Never use display text as the only oracle for numeric, rational or timestamp semantics.

recipes.purpose: Collect Raw and Rational views, stable native identity and per-occurrence provenance through a pinned reference-specific driver.
recipes.limits: The driver is not implemented or selected here. Hash/review it and demonstrate default configuration is disabled. Cases requiring these views remain not-run until it exists.

recipes.purpose: Capture one explicitly resolved preview/resource to a binary artifact and hash its bytes.
recipes.limits: Resolve resource instance first; never concatenate ambiguous matches. Capture stdout bytes directly rather than relying on shell text redirection.

recipes.purpose: Characterize individually scoped write/create/delete/refusal behavior on disposable clones.
recipes.limits: Exact operations and fault points depend on #0006. No blanket delete, direct original-file mutation, or generic successful-write inference is authorized by this recipe.

readiness: Acquire the official source/distribution for the pinned baseline and record origin, archive hash and a manifest of all executed code.
Verify actual -ver output is 13.59; otherwise fail preflight or explicitly revise the baseline.
Hash the launcher/script, module distribution, interpreter/runtime components, optional capabilities, custom configuration and observation driver.
Prove user configuration and unreviewed extensions are disabled; record complete argument arrays and controlled environment.
Record per-platform executable/runtime identities; one source version does not imply identical package capabilities.
Keep raw stdout/stderr, termination, input/output hashes, canonical observations and independent reports.
This planned profile does not claim an executable has been installed or any media experiment has run.
